diagnosis: Bad runs overrepeat actions that produce no new state or result, especially repeated clicks, no-ops, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: Tracking recent action-result signatures interrupts unproductive loops and forces reassessment or a materially different action. Expected cost: small state-tracking overhead and occasional premature switching when repetition is legitimately necessary.
policy_text: Track recent action, target, and observed-result signatures. If the same signature recurs twice without measurable state change, do not repeat it again: reassess assumptions and state, choose a materially different action, or stop and report the blocker. Permit repetition only when an explicit progress signal or protocol requires it.

quantitative_evidence.finding: Candidate runs contain 1,485 repeated operations versus 224 in base runs: 6.63× as many and a net bad-run excess of +1,261.
The repeated-result excess is +1,261 operations, including net excesses of +639 clicks, +356 no-ops, and +277 scrolls.
Traces show recurrence across tasks and agents, including repeated search clicks on consecutive steps and repeated buy-tickets clicks across many steps.
